title: How Taskin Goec Uses Clo As A Mixed Reality Designer
description:
Explore the story of Taskin Goec, a Mixed Reality Designer based in Berlin, who utilizes CLO in his entirely hybrid fashion design process. In this video, he will share his workflow, demonstrating how he moves from experimentation to producing high-fidelity visuals. His digital-first approach allows him to enhance his creativity, adaptability, and efficiency.

"I find that working with CLO is much more dynamic. It allows me to be experimental and quick and try out tons of different things up until the production level. Because designing clothes for production can be quite costly, and with CLO, I make this process much more streamlined." – Taskin Goec 

Find out more about Taskin's work here: https://www.instagram.com/taskingoec/  

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-

transcript: My name is Tashken Goetsch. I'm a mixed reality designer and today I'm going to show you how I use Clos throughout an entirely hybrid process from experimentation to creating high fidelity visuals. I studied fashion design in Berlin and London. When I started studying I already knew how Clos were made so I could really focus on the question of what I want to do differently and also what is kind of specific for the time that I live in and for me the answer was technology and I decided to teach myself Clos 3D and Blender and create those worlds that basically become my universe and that today I call the technological swamp. So when I work I start experimenting in Clos. I create a pattern which I then plot and I create a physical prototype. I test this, I fit this on a mannequin or on a person. I do some amendments. Then I digitize those amendments so I bring all of this back into Clos and then in the end I have a digital and a physical twin. I find that working with Clos is more dynamic. It allows me to be experimental and quick and try out tons of different things up until the production level because designing clothes for production can be quite costly and with Clos I make this process streamlined. I work with different people from all across the industry. Right now I'm working on a project with knitwear designer Luisa Lauber and we are bringing together her technology which is this insane knitting machine and my workflow which is the digital first approach and we are developing a lot of new techniques that are truly mixed and that bring forth new structures and new knitwear techniques that we are confident will change at least part of the industry. Something that I'm also interested in is helping clients to navigate through the landscape of technologies like Clos and to find their own and unique ways of working with it even if it's not to create digital assets eventually and if it's to make their processes more more creative and more efficient and I believe that this is how we slowly move into a mixed reality. So thank you so much for joining us and we'll see you in the next video.
